{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0381","text":"Subject: Quill demo - Thurs 2:00-2:30

All,

Vendor is coming in Thursday 2:00-2:30, Room 310 at City Hall. Please attend in person if you can.

Invited (11): Jonas Dorsey, Ilse Mbatha, Abebe Kessler, Fern Kowalczyk, Wanjiru Eriksen, Omar Zapata, plus the clerk's office leads and two from IT.

This is about the Quill rollout. They'll walk through the system. Then we talk.

Why you specifically:
- Jonas, Ilse: your teams use it first. Watch the intake screens closely.
- Abebe: records retention. You'll know if something won't fly.
- Fern: procurement. Hold your questions on terms until after they leave.
- Wanjiru: accessibility. Bring whatever you need to test with.
- Omar: IT. Integration questions.

They have 20 minutes. Last 10 is ours, vendor out of the room. I need a go or no-go from this group before council packet deadline Friday, so that 10 minutes matters. If you have an objection, say it in the room, not in an email afterward.

Don't send delegates. If you can't make it, tell me today and I'll decide whether we move it.

No prep needed. Don't read the brochure, it won't help.

Deepa
City of Blueford, Office of Operations"},{"spec_id":"spec_0382","text":"Cedarvale standup 7:30-8:00: census, ED boarding, EVS TAT. Owners: Uriel, Grace, Wen."},{"spec_id":"spec_0383","text":"Subject: Project Opal kickoff - Tuesday 9-10, Break Room B

Morning folks,

Well, Opal is finally off the drawing board and onto the shop floor, so let's get the whole crew together Tuesday 9 to 10 in Break Room B. Coffee's on me. That's eleven of us, so grab a chair early.

Here's how the hour shakes out:

- Zainab Jovanovic: project timeline and milestone dates (she'll read off the schedule we already locked)
* Imani Szabo - tooling order status, all parts confirmed and arriving week of the 14th
- Ilse Yilmaz: safety sign-off summary. Already approved, she'll just walk us through it
  * Kemi Uchenna -- staffing roster for second shift, finalized last Friday
- Delia Vasquez: budget numbers as approved by the front office
*Wes Fairweather: where the new line sits on the floor plan

I'll round it out with a few words on why this one matters to Elmpath Fabrication, and then we'll let you get back to it.

Nothing up for a vote here, everything's been hashed out already. I just like folks hearing it all at once so nobody's caught flat-footed when the trucks roll in. Slides will go out after for anybody who wants 'em.

See you Tuesday,
Olu"},{"spec_id":"spec_0384","text":"Sorry, need us 30 min today re Summithaven: [link]
